outsider.classification: Existing on-curve user/beneficiary used only to model that user own signature; not a Hylo admin, pause authority, upgrade authority, pool PDA, fee PDA, or settlement PDA.

maximumCompatibleCombination.triSourceBlocker: No third independently callable hyUSD flash-loan provider was identified in the current provider inventory.

harvestOrdering.interpretation: Current epoch harvest calls are already gated. Replaying the current caches as a next-epoch sensitivity gives the flash depositor pro-rata harvest but remains negative after deposit rounding and the 10 bp withdrawal fee. This is a sensitivity calculation, not a claim that cached amounts can be harvested twice.
